en: Exodus 27

p.src: 1  “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.

en: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.
u.src: 1  “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.

ja:
27:1 一キュビトは、大人の腕の中指の先から肘までの長さで、約十八インチ、すなわち約四十六センチメートルである。
27:1 祭壇は約二・三×二・三×一・四メートル、または約七・五×七・五×四・五フィートであった。
en:
27:1 A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters.
27:1 The altar was to be about 2.3×2.3×1.4 meters or about 7½×7½×4½ feet.

p.src: 2  You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.

en: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.
u.src: 2  You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.

p.src: 3  You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

ja: り除く壺、灰取りシャベル、
を造りなさい。器具はすべて
en: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.
u.src: 3  You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

p.src: 4  You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

ja: を造りなさい。その格子の四隅に
en: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.
u.src: 4  You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

p.src: 5  You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

ja: 、すなわち下部に取り付け、格子が
en: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.
u.src: 5  You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

p.src: 6  You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

ja: のため、アカシアの木で担ぎ
を造り、青銅をかぶせなさい。
en: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.
u.src: 6  You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

p.src: 7  Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

ja: に棒があるようにする。
en: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.
u.src: 7  Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

p.src: 8  You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.

en: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.
u.src: 8  You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.

p.src: 9  “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.

en: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.
u.src: 9  “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.

p.src: 10  Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

en: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.
u.src: 10  Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

p.src: 11  Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

ja: についても同様に、その
en: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.
u.src: 11  Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

p.src: 12  For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

en: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.
u.src: 12  For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

p.src: 13  The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

en: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.
u.src: 13  The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

p.src: 14  The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

en: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
u.src: 14  The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

p.src: 15  For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

en: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
u.src: 15  For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

p.src: 16  For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

ja: の入り口のためには、青色、紫色、緋色の糸、撚り糸で織った亜麻布で、刺繍をする者の細工による
en: For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.
u.src: 16  For the gate of the court shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer; their pillars four, and their sockets four.

p.src: 17  All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

ja: の帯飾りを付け、その掛け釘は
en: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.
u.src: 17  All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

p.src: 18  The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.

en: The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.
u.src: 18  The length of the court shall be one hundred cubits, and the width fifty throughout, and the height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and their sockets of bronze.

p.src: 19  All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.

ja: のすべての器具、そのすべての釘、および
en: All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.
u.src: 19  All the instruments of the tabernacle in all its service, and all its pins, and all the pins of the court, shall be of bronze.

p.src: 20  “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

ja: じて、ともしびのために、ついて搾った
させ、ともしびが常にともっているようにしなさい。
en: “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
u.src: 20  “You shall command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

p.src: 21  In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.

ja: える。これはイスラエルの
en: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
u.src: 21  In the Tent of Meeting, outside the veil which is before the covenant, Aaron and his sons shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD: it shall be a statute forever throughout their generations on the behalf of the children of Israel.
